text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The main opposition party in Mozambique's parliament, Renamo, failed in an attempt to amend a government bill on the armed forces on Tuesday. The former rebel movement wanted future recruitment to the armed forces to be on a party political basis, with half from the old government army, and half from the Renamo irregular forces.
- A conference to establish a development corridor from the port of Nacala along the railway line to Malawi will be held on Thursday in Nacala.
- A Unicef report published in Paris on Tuesday says the infant mortality rate in Mozambique has dropped by 21 per cent in recent years.
